**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 1  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search result regarding the "most wins" of the BBC Sports Personality of the Year award, mixing up the "Overseas SPOTY" (Muhammad Ali with 3 wins) with the "main SPOTY" category. This misclassification led to confusion and caused downstream errors, as subsequent steps focused on finding the brother of Muhammad Ali rather than Andy Murray, who holds the actual record for the most wins (3) in the main SPOTY category. The Planner failed to adequately verify the specific category being referenced before issuing the next set of instructions.
